origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): a large inline image: the reservation counts the text of the request and the image cap of the mapping (1,000 tokens) for it, not the size of the base64. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
